candidates.explanation: The confirmation URL for the new-email mail is built with the path '/confirm-email', which is the same page the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp) uses. The frontend page for '/confirm-email' calls the POST auth/email/confirm endpoint (AuthService.confirmEmail), not auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail). Following the link therefore never completes the email change. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email' so the link goes to the page that calls the email/confirm/new endpoint.
